text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, while integration tests make sure that different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before they write the code. This approach helps them find problems early and improve the design. Tests also give developers confidence. When tests pass, the team knows the software works as expected, and they can make changes without fear of breaking things. In short, testing saves time, reduces stress, and leads to better, more reliable software.
